content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify all available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md to enumerate the three allowed algorithms. Assign numeric IDs 1, 2, and 3 in the order listed, and record these IDs for later reference."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read the simulation, rate, and latency documents relevant to the candidate trigger algorithms. Extract, for each candidate and each available threshold between 20 and 60 GeV, the signal efficiency, trigger rate, and Level-1 FPGA latency."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each candidate, determine the thresholds that satisfy all hard constraints: threshold in [20, 60] GeV, signal efficiency at least 80%, latency no more than 4.0 us, and trigger rate no greater than the allocated rate. Record numeric pass/fail flags and the corresponding efficiency, rate, latency, and threshold values."},{"id":"s4","description":"Among all constraint-satisfying candidate/threshold combinations, identify the one with the highest signal efficiency. If multiple combinations have equal efficiency, prefer the one with lower trigger rate, then lower latency, then lower threshold. Record the selected algorithm ID, threshold, efficiency, trigger rate, and latency."},{"id":"s5","description":"Check that the selected combination still satisfies every hard requirement and that the algorithm ID corresponds to one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md. Record final numeric validation flags for efficiency, rate, latency, threshold range, and candidate validity."}]}
